title: The orb and what it does
summary: The orb in R.E.P.O. is an item with settings of its own: the game gives it two modes, a radius, a colour, its own sounds, and a habit of absorbing valuables.
body: The orb is an item with a mode. The game sorts orbs into two kinds, a constant one and a pulsing one, which is why two orbs can behave differently rather than being one object.
It has a radius. The orb carries a reach of its own, so what it affects is a distance rather than a point.
It is coloured. The orb keeps colour presets and a colour of its own, which is why it can be told apart at a glance.
It is battery-powered. The orb drains a battery at a rate of its own, so it is one of the items that makes charge worth carrying.
It has its own sounds. Starting, shutting down and its idle loop each have a sound, so you can hear its state without looking at it.
It absorbs valuables. There is a behaviour for a valuable being absorbed, with its own duration and the value it adds, which is why the orb is a way of collecting rather than only a tool.
Roaches orbit it. There is a roach orbit behaviour with its own radius, rotation speed and noise, which is why the orb has company as well as function.
What this entry does not tell you: how far the orb reaches, how much it absorbs, or how long its battery lasts. We have not verified those numbers, so we do not print them.

facts.claim: Orbs come in two kinds, a constant one and a pulsing one.
The orb carries a radius of its own.
It keeps colour presets and a colour of its own.
It drains a battery at its own rate.
Starting, shutting down and idling each have their own sound.
There is a behaviour for a valuable being absorbed, with a duration and a value added.
Roaches orbit the orb, with their own radius, speed and noise.
